newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to help European Parliament build HQ.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to help European Parliament build HQ.

text.p: Belgium's government said on Friday it would contribute 4.215 billion Belgian francs to the cost of the third and final stage of the European Parliament's 40-billion-franc headquarters being built in Brussels.
The so-called D3 stage of the huge complex is due to be transferred to the Parliament by developers Societe Forum Leopold (SFL) by April 1.

The latest contribution would bring the government's share of the cost to around seven billion francs, payment of which was conditional on the European Union buying the land on which the building stands, a spokeswoman said.
SFL's shareholders include Belgian real estate company Immobel, via its Entreprises Louis De Waele unit, utility group Tractebel and Belgian banking and insurance group Bacob-DVV/LAP.
